subject: Whistic onboarding: evidence claim & SOC 2 extract request
messages:
From: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic profile: request for SOC 2 extract + ownership assertion

Hi Rafael,

We're kicking off the Whistic profile for Redwood as part of our vendor onboarding. Two asks to move the profile to 'Complete' on our side:

1) A SOC 2 extract containing the control narratives & test results related to encryption-in-transit, encryption-at-rest, key management, and access control (we don't need the full report). Ideally a single PDF with the relevant sections bookmarked.
2) A one-paragraph ownership assertion confirming who will be the ongoing evidence steward and an S3 or direct upload link to the access control matrix CSV for review.

Could you upload those to the Whistic claim (https://app.whistic.com/profile/claim/ACME-3733) or send to me directly if you prefer? We also need to confirm a point of contact for annual revalidation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if easier.

Tara Nguyen
Senior InfoSec Manager
Acme Payments

Attachment: whistic_claim_instructions.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: request for SOC 2 extract + ownership assertion

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear list.

Plan: Mina will pull the SOC 2 excerpts and the access control matrix; Jonas will handle the Whistic claim upload and confirm the claim owner. I'll publish a short ownership assertion and route the signed attestation if you need it.

Quick Q: do you prefer the SOC 2 extract flattened into a single PDF (bookmarked sections) or as separate per-control files? We can do either — I recommend single PDF for the claim.

We'll aim to upload by EOD Pacific today. If we need a DocuSign attestation, please share the link and sig order.

Rafael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment (internal): request_acknowledgement.txt (txt stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>, onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: request for SOC 2 extract + ownership assertion

Tara / Rafael / Jonas — attaching the extracted material per Tara's list.

What's included in the ZIP (attachment stubs):
- acme_soc2_encrypt-access_extract.pdf — bookmarked sections: 3.2 Encryption in transit; 3.3 Encryption at rest; 4.1 Key management controls; Appendix B: control test results.
- access_control_matrix_acme.csv — canonical matrix (users, roles, permissions, resource tags, last_reviewed).
- evidence_notes.txt — short internal notes explaining redaction decisions.

Notes: we redacted direct customer PII references and test artifacts that are explicitly excluded by our legal team. Let me know if Acme needs verbatim language; otherwise these extracts cover the reviewer requirements.

I'll upload the files to the Whistic claim and paste the link when done. Rafael — you asked about the ownership assertion; suggested text below you can sign off on: 

"Redwood Inference designates the Security & Controls team (security@redwood.com) with Mina Haddad as the primary steward for vendor portal evidence and annual revalidation. The steward is responsible for maintaining and rotating evidence, coordinating attestations, and responding to remote audits."

Mina
Sr. Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_soc2_encrypt-access_extract.pdf (pdf), access_control_matrix_acme.csv (csv), evidence_notes.txt (txt)

From: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: request for SOC 2 extract + ownership assertion

Thanks, Mina — this looks like exactly what we need. A few quick items before we move the claim to Complete:

- Please upload the single PDF and the CSV to the Whistic claim URL (https://app.whistic.com/profile/claim/ACME-3733). If you already uploaded, share the upload receipt.
- We ask for a short signed attestation for the extract (one-paragraph) via DocuSign. I've created a template, please sign here: https://na1.docusign.net/CLM/example-sign-link (expires in 7 days).
- Confirm whether the access_control_matrix_acme.csv contains production resource identifiers or only role mappings (we cannot accept customer PII or resource ARNs containing customer IDs).

If you can complete upload + sign before 16:00 PT today, we will mark the claim Complete and schedule the revalidation window for next year.

Best,
Tara

Attachment: docusign_notice.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, onboarding@whistic.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: request for SOC 2 extract + ownership assertion

Tara — confirmed and completed.

What we did:
- Uploaded acme_soc2_encrypt-access_extract.pdf and access_control_matrix_acme.csv to the Whistic claim: https://app.whistic.com/profile/claim/ACME-3733
- Upload receipt: whistic_upload_receipt.txt (attached).
- Signed the DocuSign attestation (link you provided) — signature completed by Mina Haddad (Sr. Security Engineer).
- Ownership assertion published as: 
  "Redwood Inference designates the Security & Controls team (security@redwood.com) with Mina Haddad as the primary steward for vendor portal evidence and annual revalidation. The steward is responsible for maintaining and rotating evidence, coordinating attestations, and responding to remote audits."

Next steps: Jonas will verify claim status in Whistic and ping you if any follow-ups are required. Rafael to schedule a 15-minute sync if you'd like a walkthrough of the claim contents.

Thanks — Rafael

Attachments: whistic_upload_receipt.txt (txt), acme_soc2_encrypt-access_extract.pdf (pdf), access_control_matrix_acme.csv (csv)
